description: This source file defines a public actor `TranscriptsStore` that manages storing and appending transcript entries to a log file within the user's application support directory. It includes initialization logic for loading existing entries, methods for appending new entries, retrieving the latest entries, and an extension on `String` for writing lines to a file.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: A singleton actor responsible for managing a transcript log stored in a file, with functionality to load existing entries, append new entries, and retrieve the latest entries.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the `TranscriptsStore`, loads existing transcript entries from the log file if available.

methods.name: append(text: String)
methods.description: Appends a new text entry to the transcript log, maintaining the maximum limit of entries.

methods.name: latest() -> [String]
methods.description: Returns the most recent transcript entries up to the limit.
